messages.task:
You are a financial analysis assistant. You have access to several callable tools that can retrieve information from an internal data store and perform basic calculations. Rely on these tools whenever possible and show only the final answer to the user.

Scenario
A global lifestyle company distributes Ralph-Lauren–branded products through wholesale channels around the world.  The company keeps track of the number of “doors” (individual points of sale) in each geography.  A narrative excerpt explains that its wholesale products reach consumers through department stores and specialty shops in the United States & Canada, Europe and Asia.  The excerpt also notes that the company maintains a worldwide total of doors.  (The exact counts are stored in an internal table that you can access only through the tools.)

Available tools
• list_all_region_names() – return every canonical region name stored in the database
• list_aliases_for_region(region_name) – return every alias that refers to the supplied canonical region name
• get_region_canonical_name(possible_name) – resolve any canonical name or alias to the canonical region name
• get_latest_metric_value(region_name, metric_name) – return the most recent value recorded for the specified metric (e.g. "door_count") for the region
• get_metric_history(region_name, metric_name) – return the full dated history of a metric for a region, newest first
• compute_percentage(part, whole, decimals=0) – convert two numbers into a percentage string

Question
What percentage of the total doors is represented by the United States and Canada geography?

When you are confident, respond with the percentage only (e.g. “55%”).
